description: A search cancelled while in flight. The fixture makes every td invocation take thirty seconds, so the cancel notification arrives while the probes are still running; the adapter abandons them and answers with an error rather than a late result. The code is -32007 deadline_exceeded: an abandoned request ran out of time, which is a different condition from declining a budget up front.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
